title: test(dogfood): the upgrade fixtures read as written the day before the run, so a boot's rotation never drops their activity shard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28849

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:升级测试用的 18.0 / 18.0.0 夹具数据库,加载时把活动流(`sys_activity`)的按日分片表重命名为“运行日前一天”,四个测试从此不再随日历过期;只改测试侧,产品的保留期与轮转逻辑一行未动。
- **为什么改**:夹具里的活动分片以生成当天命名(10-19 / 10-20),每次启动都会按真实时钟删掉 14 天前的分片;11-02 起 18.0 夹具的四个 dogfood 用例全红,18.0.0 夹具 11-03 也会跟着红。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只涉及 dogfood(私有包,不发布)与 `turbo.json` 的一条测试输入声明;回滚即 revert 本 PR,代价是这批用例重新随日期变红。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-as-of.ts`(重命名逻辑与为何不钉时钟);`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness-fixture-as-of.test.ts`(用真实轮转在多个日期验证);`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts`(两处夹具读取改走新入口)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/upgrade-harness-fixture-as-of.test.ts`,预期 22 个用例全绿(含“按原样读取则分片被删”的对照用例)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-as-of.ts`: `readFixtureAsOf(dir, nowMs = Date.now())` reads a fixture's `database.sql` and `manifest.json` and re-dates every rotation shard the dump creates (`sys_activity__rYYYYMMDD`) so the newest one is the day before the run, every shard keeping its distance from the newest. The rename happens in the SQL text before loading, in one pass, so the shard table, the indexes named after it and its INSERTs move together; the manifest's `physical` names and `tables` keys go through the same map. A shard of a family it cannot re-date (anything but a day key of a listed family) is refused, never loaded on the wall clock.
- Every 18.0 and 18.0.0 fixture load goes through it: `upgrade-18x-harness` (both describes), `audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies`, `identity-mail-read-gate`, `upgrade-18x-index-equivalence`.
- New `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness-fixture-as-of.test.ts`: runs the real rotation (`SqlDriver#rotateShards`, with `sys_activity`'s own declaration imported from source) over each fixture at run dates from 20 days before the shard to 400 days after it; the re-dated shard must be retained with every row, beside a fresh current shard. Control: the fixture read as written loses its shard at day 14.
- `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`: declare `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-activity.object.ts` as a dogfood test input, since the new test imports it from source (`check:cross-package-test-inputs` asked for it).

## Why

`sys_activity` is a rotation object (`lifecycle.storage: { strategy: 'rotation', shards: 14, unit: 'day' }`). Every boot runs driver-sql's `ensureRotation` against `Date.now()` and drops each shard older than the window. The fixture's activity rows live in `sys_activity__r20261019` (18.0) and `sys_activity__r20261020` (18.0.0), so the 18.0 suites went red when the UTC day turned to 2026-11-02, and the 18.0.0 leg would follow on 2026-11-03.

Why re-dating the shard and not pinning the clock: the fixture is opened by two kinds of process. One is the test's own boots. The other is each `os migrate organization-ownership`, `os migrate audit-key-material`, `os migrate audit-mail-bodies` and `os migrate plan` binary the suites spawn, and those run the same rotation on their own clock (the `expected 8, got 4` failure is the spawned `--apply` dropping the shard). A pinned clock would have to be injected into every one of those processes and would move every timestamp they write (sessions, deliveries, audit rows) with it. The only product seam for the time, `ensureRotation(..., nowMs)`, is not reachable from a boot without a product change. The shard name is the only thing the rotation reads, so it is the only thing re-dated; row timestamps stay as the fixture recorded them (reads go through the `UNION ALL` view over every retained shard, never by row timestamp).

Why the day before the run rather than the run's own day: the fixture is a database an earlier install wrote, so HEAD's boot rotates in a shard of its own beside it, as on a real upgrade. The 18.0.0 leg's "HEAD's shard NOT NULL" and "shard residue" readings depend on that. A run that crosses UTC midnight still finds the fixture's shard inside the window.

## Tests

<details><summary>Before (origin/main 3e62a22c4f, run date 2026-11-02): 4 failed, exactly the triage's four</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts test/audit-key-material.dogfood.test.ts test/audit-mail-bodies.dogfood.test.ts test/identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts test/upgrade-18x-index-equivalence.dogfood.test.ts

 FAIL  test/audit-key-material.dogfood.test.ts > ... > 2. --apply leaves 0 copies carrying one ...
AssertionError: expected 4 to be 8
 FAIL  test/audit-mail-bodies.dogfood.test.ts > ... > 2. --apply leaves 0 clear copies ...
AssertionError: expected 2 to be 4
 FAIL  test/identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts > ... > sys_activity: the platform admin reads the 18.0 copy ...
AssertionError: expected 0 to be greater than 0
 FAIL  test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts > [#24522] ... > 3. every 18.0 row of every reshaped table is where the ceremony put it ...
Error: no such table: sys_activity__r20261019
 Test Files  4 failed | 1 passed (5)
      Tests  4 failed | 55 passed (59)
```

The same base with the clock shifted one day ahead in every process (a local `--import` preload, not committed) adds the 18.0.0 leg's two failures, `no such table: sys_activity__r20261020` and the missing shard residue: tomorrow's red.
</details>

<details><summary>After (head 48a5608202): all green today, and at simulated run dates +1, +30 and +180 days</summary>

```
same five files + test/upgrade-harness-fixture-as-of.test.ts
 Test Files  6 passed (6)
      Tests  81 passed (81)

clock shifted +1 / +30 / +180 days in every process (vitest, workers, each spawned os binary), the five dogfood files:
 Test Files  5 passed (5)   Tests  59 passed (59)   (each of the three runs)
```

The assertions measure what they measured before: step 3 now finds every fixture activity row by id in the re-dated shard, and the audit commands count and rewrite the fixture's full 8 and 4 activity copies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `fixture-18.0.0-next.5` (the CLI prerelease fixture) carries no rotation shard, so its loader is unchanged.
- Only day-unit shard keys are re-dated; no fixture carries a week or month family today, and one would be refused loudly at load.
- No changeset: every changed file is in the private `@objectstack/dogfood` package or repo-root config (`turbo.json`, `scripts/`), which publish nothing.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0 (the package's `tsconfig.json` includes `test/**/*`, so the new files are compiled).
- `eslint` on every touched `.ts` / `.mjs` file: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 69 derived families, 68 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it reads the whole tree's `dist/` and only the dogfood closure was built; CI runs it). `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` first exited 1 on the new source import, and exits 0 after the declaration in the second commit.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
</details>
